title: Supervised fine-tuning trajectory record (one JSON object per line)
description: The schema of each line of train.jsonl. One record is ONE EPISODE (one calendar month), not one decision.

messages.description: Append-only chat transcript for the whole episode: one system message, then alternating user (observation) and assistant (order lines) turns. Roughly 49-77 messages per episode.

step_loss_mask.description: 1 = train on this message's tokens. Set only on assistant turns. THIS is the field the trainer reads; a top-level loss_mask alone is silently ignored by the trainer used here.

loss_mask.description: Per-message mirror of step_loss_mask, same length as messages. Retained for trainers that expect a top-level mask. The per-message field is authoritative.

env_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the resolved environment configuration. Every record in a corpus must agree, and must match the evaluation environment, or the corpus and the results describe different environments.

teacher_model.description: Model identifier that produced the assistant turns.

decisions.description: Number of decision steps in the episode.

tokens.description: Episode length under token_counter. Must not exceed max_tokens.

token_counter.description: Identifier of the tokenizer used, e.g. tokenizer.json:<digest>. A character heuristic under-counts this state space by ~1.85x and must not be used to size a budget.

max_tokens.description: Content budget applied at corpus-build time. 32768 for the reported runs.

dropped_over_max_tokens.description: Episodes excluded for exceeding the budget. Present even when empty: 'nothing exceeded the cap' and 'no cap was applied' are different facts.
